description: A dimly lit oil-style painting of a 1930s-looking room. A man in a white coat leans over a black metal box with a dial and cables on a side table. A second man in a white coat stands at the head of a cot, placing a headband or electrode on a reclining patient's head. A woman in a dark dress stands at the right edge. The patient is calm and nothing is bloody. There is no visible text, no frame, and the painting fills the canvas.
